body:
CHIEF DISPOSITION: ACCEPT THE TARGET, NOT THE ADMISSION.

1. Sherlock is now the canonical target pair for the external local video-recall vertical because the exact media, coder atlas, and 17 recalls are locally present and identity-addressable. Its current status is SelectedPendingDecision and NotAdmitted. War of the Ghosts remains the public text acceptance fixture. Sherlock is not yet a lawful F2 corpus, calibrated validation set, direct episode truth, or vendorable fixture.

2. The owner instruction authorizes organization, planning, content-free inventory, and fail-closed protection of the local files. It does not by itself establish media or annotation licence, consent, REB, redistribution, remote processing, or publication. Those owner-action leaves remain open and must be explicit.

3. New P0 bead bd-01M1CH1SW9K3ZW8D0HBTH9JVRP owns the first bounded slice. Exact paths are docs/design/sherlock-local-pair-admission-court.md and .gitignore only. The ignore change is a root /tmp/ rule so the current media, annotations, recalls, aliases, nested checkout, and local manifests disappear from ordinary Git status without deleting or moving them.

4. Use a separate admission court, not an amendment to the closed public source audit and not a duplicate component-ledger row. The public audit remains evidence about released records; the new court records this realized local pair and every status that still refuses use. No verifier or film API in this slice.

5. Quarantine all sub-N aliases. Do not delete them and do not use them as canonical participant identity until one complete checked 17-entry mapping proves the source identity, the omitted record, and the pseudonym policy. Participant filenames and raw hashes stay out of Git and the board; a future receipt uses the project sensitive-digest boundary.

The bead body contains the exact acceptance checklist, content exclusions, named reviewers, and author gate. Claim and reserve only those two paths, then respond before editing.
